title: Decouple tests/unit/test_secrets_baseline.py from one hardcoded GitHub fixture path via at-test-time discovery
objective: test_secrets_baseline.py hardcoded MULTI_ENTRY_FILE = a GitHub-provider fixture; ~8 tests depended on that exact path having several entries. The tests need A multi-entry file, not THAT file. Replace the constant with deterministic at-test-time discovery from the committed baseline, failing loudly by name when no file meets the minimum. No security behaviour of the guard changes.
in_scope: Add MINIMUM_ENTRIES=2 and discover_multi_entry_file(results): most-entried key, ties broken lexicographically (sorted keys + strictly-greater winner), raising AssertionError by name when none meets the minimum.
Add a multi_entry_file fixture; migrate the ~8 coupled tests to it.
Add proof tests: discovery selects the richest file deterministically (order-independent), survives the formerly-hardcoded fixture disappearing, and fails loudly on no-multi-entry / empty baselines.
out_of_scope: Editing .secrets.baseline (protected), .github/workflows/ci.yml, agent-state/feature_list.json, package-lock.json files, scripts/check_urls.py, tests/unit/test_url_allowlist.py.
Any npm install/update/audit fix; docker/npm ci are environmentally broken and untouched.
acceptance_criteria: discover_multi_entry_file returns the unique richest baseline file (Oracle capture, 26 entries) and is order-independent.
With the GitHub fixture removed in-memory, discovery selects a different file >= MINIMUM_ENTRIES and the DISAPPEARED/DECREASED checks still fire.
With no file >= MINIMUM_ENTRIES, the named discovery test fails with a message stating the minimum and the richest candidate seen.

Every pre-existing guard behaviour (mode A wipe/removal/decrease, mode B backslash + directional-invisibility, deletion-is-a-change, legitimate refresh passes, growth passes, generated_at churn never fails, wiring routes) still holds.
Mutation reinstating each tampering kills the corresponding named test.
Full pytest suite passes; ruff check . and ruff format --check . pass; collected count for the file rises 141 -> 146 with no test removed.
